change.behavior: Ignore music ended while a replacement occurrence is being prepared, before updating cadence or queue history.
change.basis: Both independent reviewers identified the persistent callback window between synchronous live-index change and effect-driven source replacement. Root proposed reusing preparing instead of adding a source-token subsystem; both audited every occurrence mutation and accepted.
change.nativeReproduction: Exact queued-ended then Next ordering was not forcibly reproduced. This is a source-identified race guard with focused final-native regression/positive controls, not a claim of an observed double advance.

obligations.title: Repeat and shuffle after speech

obligations.title: Durable heard exclusion
obligations.behavior: Actual or ambiguous invoked playback must not reenter automatic delivery after failed marker/restart.

obligations.title: Late preparation and placement
obligations.behavior: Old music loads or saved-pool callbacks cannot override a newer queue/profile/intent.
obligations.currentSource: load token/key and placement generation fences; controller cancellation releases exact claim; write/recovery gates prevent unowned dispatch.
obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: Resolved handoff/controller comparisons, current PR121 token service/native cancellation, final held replacement resource with paused newer entry. Unresolved older load-recovery hash is excluded from current source transfer.

obligations.title: Delayed start gate
obligations.behavior: History save must precede speech; pause/rewind/cancel and recovery must fence a late result.

obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: Current PR121 held start/cancel; fresh over-music held start followed by rewind/release stays silent, music-first resume and later one actual speech play.

obligations.title: Canonical story variants
obligations.behavior: A reserved or consumed story must not be independently auto-claimed under another tracking variant.
obligations.currentSource: Automatic CAS checks claimed/started/played canonical URLs; all claim/start/release/mark operations guard exact token.
obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: Current PR121 race and stale-token service checks; fresh controller automatic path passes its actual lease token.

obligations.title: Ending event ownership
obligations.behavior: A queued outgoing music end must not act on the new live queue entry while its source is being replaced.
obligations.currentSource: New preparing early guard; changeTrack/play/restore/remove-current set flag before occurrence mutation; load clears outgoing src before flag release; endpoint/exhaustion synchronously clear source and consume generation.
obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: Independent source path audit and final genuine-end/delayed-resource controls. Exact browser queued-event order not forcibly reproduced; source guard closes identified preparation window.

obligations.title: Speech remains separate from music
obligations.behavior: Speech preparation/playback does not add music queue entries, favorite/history mutations or provider calls during listening.
obligations.currentSource: Only music natural-ended path increments completedSongs; prepared speech uses a separate Audio element; playback APIs have no provider dispatch.
obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: Fresh32 states retain the same four music IDs and zero text/audio preparation/external attempts; PR121 service provenance/selection and CI4/CI5/CI3 records retain scopes.

obligations.title: Failure and feedback
obligations.behavior: Failed start/history remains understandable without retrying a song or silently replaying a story.
obligations.currentSource: Current dedicated DJ notice survives automatic load; Last heard is actual onplay and retains completed/interrupted session status.
obligations.evidenceAndJudgment: PR121 visible failure/marker notices, final automatic Played to end and reset countdown; listener comprehension and audible quality remain separate.

freshness.exclusion: Twelve unresolved evidence file versions are listed, principally old listening/endpoint/load-main/storage/player/control variants. They do not establish source freshness and are not transferred as current proof. Other resolved scopes from a record retain only their explicit node/behavior scope.

native.method: CUA native input only. Playwright owns launch/close and passive DOM/media/main-call telemetry; four owned processes. Actual current renderer/preload/main with isolated user data/key/network adapters and controlled main IPC gates. Real muted40-second WAV music and13.92-second MP3 speech. Natural ends use native slider Home/Prior/Right to39.2 then Play; no synthetic event, private counter manipulation or media-time JS setter. First shuffle observer lacks passive event capture; later runs capture native play/pause/ended and final run captures clicks.
native.versions: First three runs use PR121 source before the one-line ended guard. Final run uses current final build and covers held replacement loading, paused release, real natural cadence, automatic token reservation/delivery/continuation and countdown reset. Earlier source-current speech handling remains unchanged except the additional music-ending guard. No whole final-bundle rerun of all old matrices is claimed.
native.cleanup: All four owned observers terminal exit0; owned localhost5199 server stopped with terminal143. No external/provider request or real Jellyfin change.

conclusion: CI6 documented engineering obligations now have individual current source/retained/fresh native-service adjudications. The identified outgoing-ended preparation window is guarded. Complete atomic requirement denominator and named listener/live/platform requirements remain unachieved under Q13; the goal stays active.
limits: No forced native reproduction of the exact queued music-ended event interleaving; source guard and adjacent real-event controls retain those distinct meanings.

No browser-event model establishes arbitrary task scheduling after a later source has itself ended. A delayed old event observing a genuinely ended current resource is not proven as a reproduced case here.
Old unresolvable source hashes are explicitly excluded; finite matrices and source review do not prove every network timing or arbitrary concurrent mutation.
Controlled conversion-route WAV in retained matrices is not live-codec/audible/system proof; separately recorded live evidence keeps its own limits.
No new regular listener, audible content/mix, real provider/server, VoiceOver/hardware, sleep/power-loss, physical disk-fault or platform-matrix result.
Only1280x720 normal zoom baseline; smaller windows/enlarged zoom remain deferred. No overall90percent or whole-goal completion claim.
